response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no discernible background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Strong, long-tenured software engineering career with senior/staff-level titles
Broad technical range across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded/low-latency systems (DLang, async I/O)
Demonstrated leadership via talks, workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
Career trajectory is entirely in web/app/backend development, not chip or systems performance engineering

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, or deep-learning performance optimization background
Solid general software engineering seniority and experience
